blocks.text: Jab fluid aise pipe mein behta hai jis ka cross-section aur oonchai badalti rahe, to pipe ke saath saath pressure bhi badalta hai. Bernoulli's equation fluid dynamics (behte fluids ki physics) ki bunyadi equation hai jo pressure ko fluid ki speed aur oonchai se jorti hai.

Bernoulli's equation nikalte waqt hum farz karte hain ke fluid incompressible (dabaya na ja sake), non-viscous (andar koi ragar nahi) hai aur steady behta hai. Time t mein pipe se fluid ka bahao dekhein (Fig. 5.16).

blocks.alt: Pipe baen taraf oonchai par chaure hisse se mur kar daen taraf neeche tang hisse tak jata hai, neeche zameen ki lakeer hai. Baen taraf dabao P1 mass delta m, lambai delta x1 aur raqba A1 ki peeli tukri ko dhakelta hai jo speed v1 se oonchai h1 par hai. Daen taraf usi mass delta m ki narangi tukri, lambi delta x2 aur raqba A2, speed v2 se oonchai h2 par hai, aur dabao P2 use daen se peechhe dhakelta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.16: Ghair-yaksaan cross-section ke pipe mein mukhtalif oonchaiyon par fluid ka ideal bahao (kitab ki Figure 5.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono shaded tukron ka mass Δm barabar hai. Patle hisse mein area A₂ chhota hai, is liye wahi mass lambe tukre (Δx₂ > Δx₁) mein phailta hai aur speed v₂ zyada hoti hai. P₁ fluid par kaam karta hai aur P₂ us ke khilaf; yahi kaam K.E. aur P.E. badalne mein lagta hai.
Fluid ke oopar wale sire par force P₁A₁ hai; P₁ wahan pressure aur A₁ cross-sectional area hai. Peechhe wala fluid is fluid ko Δx₁ faasla dhakelta hai, to kiya gaya kaam:

blocks.latex: W_1 = F_1 \Delta x_1 = P_1 A_1 \Delta x_1

blocks.text: Isi tarah neeche wale sire par fluid par kaam:

Yahan P₂ pressure, A₂ neeche wale sire ka cross-sectional area aur Δx₂ usi time t mein fluid ka tay kiya faasla hai. W₂ manfi (negative) hai kyun ke yeh kaam fluid ki force ke khilaf hota hai. Kul kaam:

blocks.latex: \text{or}\quad W = P_1 A_1 \Delta x_1 - P_2 A_2 \Delta x_2 \qquad (5.19)

blocks.text: Agar oopar aur neeche wale siron par velocities v₁ aur v₂ hon (Δx = vt), to:

blocks.title: Brain Teaser!
blocks.text: Baseball mein curveball (mur kar jane wali gend) ka Bernoulli's principle se kya talluq hai?

blocks.prompt: Brain Teaser ka jawab: curveball ka Bernoulli's principle se kya talluq hai?
blocks.explanation: Curveball spin (ghumte hue) phenki jati hai. Ghoomti gend ek taraf ki hawa ko apne saath ghaseet kar us taraf hawa ki speed barha deti hai aur doosri taraf kam kar deti hai. Bernoulli's principle ke mutabiq jahan hawa tez hai wahan pressure kam hota hai; is pressure ke farq se gend tez hawa wali (kam pressure wali) taraf mur jati hai. Yeh Magnus effect hai (5.12 mein 'Swing of a Ball').

blocks.latex: \text{Hence}\quad A_1 v_1 t = A_2 v_2 t = V\ (\text{volume})

blocks.text: Agar mass m aur density ρ ho to:
Is kaam ka kuch hissa fluid ki K.E. (kinetic energy, harkat ki energy) badalne mein aur kuch hissa gravitational P.E. (oonchai ki potential energy) badalne mein lagta hai:

blocks.text_alt: Change in K.E. ΔK.E. = ½mv₂² − ½mv₁²   (5.22)
Change in P.E. ΔP.E. = mgh₂ − mgh₁   (5.23)

blocks.text: Yahan h₁ aur h₂ oopar aur neeche wale siron ki oonchaiyan hain.
Fluid ke is volume par energy ke conservation (bachao) ka qanoon lagayein to:

blocks.text_alt: (P₁ − P₂) m/ρ = ½mv₂² − ½mv₁² + mgh₂ − mgh₁   (5.24)

blocks.text: Equation (5.24) ko m/ρ se taqseem kar ke (yani har term ko ρ/m se zarab de kar) aur terms ko tarteeb dene se:

blocks.latex: P_1 + \frac{1}{2}\rho v_1^2 + \rho g h_1 = P_2 + \frac{1}{2}\rho v_2^2 + \rho g h_2
blocks.text_alt: P₁ + ½ρv₁² + ρgh₁ = P₂ + ½ρv₂² + ρgh₂

blocks.text: Yahi Bernoulli's equation hai, jo aksar is shakal mein likhi jati hai:

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: P pressure hai, ½ρv² har unit volume ki kinetic energy aur ρgh har unit volume ki potential energy. Steady, incompressible aur non-viscous bahao ke har point par in teenon ka jor (sum) barabar rehta hai: jahan fluid tez ho wahan pressure kam hota hai.

blocks.caption: Derivation qadam ba qadam
rows: W = P₁A₁Δx₁ − P₂A₂Δx₂ (5.19) = (P₁ − P₂)V (5.20) = (P₁ − P₂) m/ρ (5.21)
ΔK.E. = ½mv₂² − ½mv₁² (5.22); ΔP.E. = mgh₂ − mgh₁ (5.23)
P₁ + ½ρv₁² + ρgh₁ = P₂ + ½ρv₂² + ρgh₂

blocks.prompt: Ek horizontal pipe mein point 1 par pani 3 m s⁻¹ se beh raha hai aur pressure 200 000 Pa hai; nozzle par pressure 101 300 Pa hai. Nozzle se nikalne wale pani ki speed nikalein. Aur: Bernoulli ke mutabiq barabar motai ke horizontal pipe mein pressure constant rehna chahiye, phir bhi asal mein pipe ke saath girta hai; kyun?
blocks.explanation: Horizontal pipe mein h₁ = h₂, is liye P₁ + ½ρv₁² = P₂ + ½ρv₂². v₂² = v₁² + 2(P₁ − P₂)/ρ = 9 + 2 × 98 700 / 1000 = 9 + 197.4 = 206.4, is liye v₂ ≈ 14.4 m s⁻¹. Bernoulli non-viscous fluid farz karta hai; asal fluid deewaron aur tahon ki viscous ragar mein energy khota hai, is liye barabar pipe mein bhi pressure aahista aahista girta hai.

items: Siron par pressure ka kaam W = (P₁ − P₂)V = (P₁ − P₂) m/ρ, jo ΔK.E. + ΔP.E. ke barabar hai (incompressible, non-viscous, steady fluid).
Bernoulli: P₁ + ½ρv₁² + ρgh₁ = P₂ + ½ρv₂² + ρgh₂, ya P + ½ρv² + ρgh = constant.
Jahan speed zyada, wahan pressure kam.
